 6th Match, Doha Sat 21 Nov Bangladesh A Afghanistan A Sat 21 Nov, 10:00 GMT 
 Here are the predictions for ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 matches 5 and 6, featuring Sri Lanka A vs Hong Kong and Bangladesh A vs Afghanistan A, to be played on November 21 at the University of Doha and West End Park Stadium.
 Match Prediction - Sri Lanka A v Hong Kong 
 LIVE SCORES - 5th Match - Sri Lanka A vs Hong Kong (University of Doha for Science and Technology, Doha) 
 Current Form Sri Lanka A: 
 Sri Lanka A are currently placed at the 1st position on Group A points table with 1 win to their credit.
 The top run scorer for Sri Lanka A in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 is Lasith Croospulle with 40 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Sri Lanka A in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 is Chamika Karunaratne with 3 scalps under his belt.
 Sri Lanka A have won their previous match against Afghanistan A by 6 wickets.
 Afghanistan A batted first and they posted a total of 139 before being bowled out. Imran Mir, Hassan Eisakhil and Faisal Shinozada all got out without troubling the scorers much. Darwish Rasooli at number 4 fought hard and scored 80 runs but he failed to get any support from his batting partners. Wickets kept falling in regular succession as Chamika Heenatigala picked up 3 wickets and wrapped the Afghanistan A innings at a small total of 139.
 During the chase, Lasith Croospulle and Sineth Jayawardena started off very well. Croospulle made 40 runs while Sineth scored 28 runs in only 15 balls. Nishan Madushka and Pavan Rathnayake also contributed healthily and helped Sri Lanka A get home in the 22nd over itself with 6 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Hong Kong: 
 Hong Kong are currently placed at the 3rd position on Group A points table with 1 loss to their credit.
 The top run scorer for Hong Kong in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 is Anshuman Rath with 70 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Hong Kong in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 is Ateeq Iqbal with 1 scalp under his belt.
 Hong Kong have lost their previous match against Bangladesh A by 8 wickets.
 Hong Kong batted first and they posted a total of 219 for 8 in 50 overs. Zeeshan Ali consumed 21 deliveries for his knock of 10 runs. Hong Kong failed to utilise the Powerplay overs. Anshuman Rath and Aizaz Khan tried to revive the innings with knocks of 77 and 67 runs respectively. Aizaz Khan however consumed 106 balls for his slow paced knock and it didn't help the team much. The lower order batters also failed to infuse any momentum into the innings and Hong Kong were eventually restricted to an under par total of 219 in 50 overs of play.
 During the chase, Bangladesh A lost the key wikcet of Parvez Hossain Emon quite early. After his dismissal, Saif Hassan and Shahadat Hossain Dipu played like champions and scored 86 and 43 runs respectively. Yasir Ali Chowdhury also played to his potential and smashed 71 runs off 51 deliveries to help Bangladesh A get over the line in the 41st over itself with 8 wickets in hand.
